summary: Of 24 eligible failures, 12 concern URL/proxy behavior or diagnostics, 7 statement parsing/diagnostics, 4 color output, and 1 symlink-selected ungron mode.

groups.label: URL and proxy behavior
groups.observed_summary: 4 proxy-routing/bypass cases, 3 URL-handling cases, and 1 timeout case show behavioral mismatches.

groups.label: Statement parsing and diagnostics
groups.observed_summary: 7 cases cover malformed-input diagnostics, tolerated separators/statements, and values-mode error status.

groups.label: Color output
groups.observed_summary: 4 cases record plain output where ANSI color output is expected.

groups.label: Network error-message compatibility
groups.observed_summary: 4 cases fail exact diagnostic expectations while the candidate returns fetch-error status 4. The TLS certificate was rejected.

groups.label: Symlink-selected ungron mode
groups.observed_summary: 1 case invokes the ungron symlink but receives a JSON-parser error instead of successful reverse conversion.

cases.name: tests.test_gaps.test_colorize_gron_output
cases.expected_assertion: Color-requested output contains ANSI sequences and matches the color golden output.
cases.observed_assertion_mismatch: The recorded candidate output is plain, without the expected ANSI escape sequences. The ungron golden comparison also shows pretty JSON instead of the expected compact colorized form.
cases.inferred_cause_not_source_verified: Color option handling or color rendering appears absent/incomplete. The assertions do not identify the implementation mechanism.

cases.inferred_cause_not_source_verified: The executable-name-based ungron mode appears unrecognized or lost by its launcher; this is an inference, not a source inspection.

cases.name: tests.test_url_fetch.test_fetch_connection_refused
cases.expected_assertion: Error contains lowercase connection refused.
cases.observed_assertion_mismatch: Exit status is 4, but stderr uses [Errno 111] Connection refused with a capital C.
cases.inferred_cause_not_source_verified: Underlying runtime diagnostic formatting differs; malformed proxy URL interpretation may also differ. Correct failure exit status does not imply exact message compatibility.

cases.name: tests.test_url_fetch.test_fetch_nonexistent_domain

cases.inferred_cause_not_source_verified: Underlying runtime diagnostic formatting differs; malformed proxy URL interpretation may also differ. Correct failure exit status does not imply exact message compatibility.

cases.inferred_cause_not_source_verified: The URL-versus-file detector appears case-sensitive.

cases.name: tests.test_url_fetch.test_fetch_url_with_unicode_in_query

cases.name: tests.test_url_fetch.test_timeout_on_slow_response

cases.observed_assertion_mismatch: Candidate returns exit status 0 and normal gron output for the slow response.
cases.inferred_cause_not_source_verified: Timeout handling or its configured threshold differs; the assertion does not establish the precise implementation cause.

interpretation_notes: Counts are failed test cases, not independent defects; several cases exercise the same behavior.
Observed assertions come from the frozen candidate official evaluator output after official active-branch/ignored-test filters.
Inferred causes are hypotheses from assertion text, not claims established by inspecting or changing candidate source.
The self-signed TLS case rejected the certificate; its failure is diagnostic wording, not certificate acceptance.
No candidate changes, inference, or evaluation reruns were performed for this analysis.
